title: Custom-shader cursor uniform adds the glyph's Y bearing (measured up from the cell bottom) to a y-down top-of-cell coordinate
expected_finding: iCurrentCursor.y is computed as the cell's top edge in y-down fragCoord pixels plus bearings[1]; the Y bearing is a y-up distance from the cell bottom to the glyph top, so the sum is neither edge of the cursor (for the underline cursor it lands 2 px below the cell top instead of at the cell bottom), and the shader's cursor rectangle [y - h, y] is drawn at the wrong height
